Sysvar read, write, init, derive, and update logic for the last restart slot.

# Purpose
This file implements the `last_restart_slot` sysvar support for the bank and account database. It provides functions to write the sysvar account, initialize it when the feature is active, read it back from `funk`, and update it when the stored slot changes. The code uses the sysvar account ID `fd_sysvar_last_restart_slot_id`, encodes and decodes the `fd_sol_sysvar_last_restart_slot_t` data, and routes account updates through `fd_sysvar_account_update`.

The file also defines [`fd_sysvar_last_restart_slot_derive`](<#fd_sysvar_last_restart_slot_derive>), which selects the restart slot from the hard fork list for a given current slot. If no hard forks exist, it returns `0`, and otherwise it scans the hard fork slots from newest to oldest and returns the latest slot that is not greater than `current_slot`. The update path checks the `last_restart_slot_sysvar` feature gate before it reads or writes the account, and it avoids rewriting the account when the stored slot already matches the requested value.
